presetSelection.title: Quick Setup

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.tip: Self-leveling keeps you in control. Slow rates prevent overcorrection. Perfect for your first flights!

cinematic.name: Cinematic
cinematic.tip: Low rates + high expo = buttery smooth movements. GPS position hold for stable shots. RTH for safety.

flyingWing.description: Delta wings & flying wings with elevon mixing
flyingWing.name: Flying Wing
flyingWing.tip: Elevon mixing configured (left/right servos on CH3/CH4). Auto-launch, RTH, and waypoint navigation ready.

freestyle.name: Freestyle
freestyle.tip: Three-position switch gives ANGLE/HORIZON/ACRO. AIRMODE keeps control at zero throttle for flips!

fwGlider.name: Glider
fwGlider.tip: Optimized for glide efficiency. Low rates for precision. Soaring mode for thermals. Flying wing servo setup.

fwLongRange.name: Long Range FPV
fwLongRange.tip: Flying wing setup optimized for efficiency. Full navigation suite with waypoints, cruise, and RTH.

fwSport.description: Agile traditional airplane for experienced pilots
fwSport.name: Sport Plane
fwSport.tip: Higher rates for aerobatics. Aileron/elevator/rudder setup. Switch between stabilized and acro modes.

fwTrainer.name: Trainer Plane
fwTrainer.tip: Classic aileron/elevator/rudder setup. Auto-level keeps wings stable. Perfect for learning fixed-wing flying.

longRange.name: Long Range
longRange.tip: Conservative PIDs for efficiency. GPS cruise and RTH for safety. ANGLE mode for easy recovery.

racing.name: Racing
racing.tip: Pure ACRO for maximum control. High rates for quick corrections. Beeper helps find crashes!
